title: The Honolulu trip with C.P. Johnson's band
summary: C.P. Johnson's band goes to the islands but the leader is arrested for marijuana; Callender stays on and later returns to the symphony.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: So after the record band... This was after I had done a lot of records with Charlie Parker and Wardell and Dexter

and Erroll, Harold West, and a bunch of other people. Then the record band started. This was in '47. So C.P. Johnson, who had had a band around town that I had been writing for, gets a gig in Honolulu...or not Honolulu but all the islands. So Trummy Young and Dexter and I, and Ulysses Livingston, and Arthur Dennis (and I can't think of the trumpeter's name at the moment), we all go to Honolulu. So just the day before we go to Honolulu, C.P. gets busted for marijuana. And the headlines when we get to Honolulu is, "Bandleader jailed for marijuana." So I think we did two or three gigs, and that wiped that out.
That was all you stayed in that one...
